description: email.rs:1072-1073 doc comment says 'Blobs not found → notParsable'. The implementation is the opposite: blobs that exist but fail parse go to notParsable; blobs that do not exist go to notFound (email.rs:1118-1124). A contributor reading only the doc will implement a backend or write tests expecting not-found blobs to produce notParsable, violating RFC 8621 §5.8. The routing logic is correct; the doc comment is the bug.
title: handle_email_parse doc comment: notFound vs notParsable routing is wrong
